Hi there! I'm a bike messenger by day, aspiring actor by night, and this is my website. I live in Los Angeles, have a great dog named Jack, and I like piña coladas. (And gettin' caught in the rain.)

...or something like this:

The XYZ Doohickey Company was founded in 1971, and has been providing quality doohickeys to the public ever since. Located in Gotham City, XYZ employs over 2,000 people and does all kinds of awesome things for the Gotham community.

As a new WordPress user, you should go to your dashboard to delete this page and create new pages for your content. Have fun!

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: monotheme
item.content:encoded:
Who we are

Suggested text: Our website address is: https://mono.everestthemes.com.

Comments

Suggested text: When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

Suggested text: If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Cookies

Suggested text: If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select "Remember Me", your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Suggested text: Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Who we share your data with

Suggested text: If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

How long we retain your data

Suggested text: If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

Suggested text: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where your data is sent

Suggested text: Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

item.title: Refund and Returns Policy
item.dc:creator: monotheme
item.content:encoded:
This is a sample page.

Overview

Our refund and returns policy lasts 30 days. If 30 days have passed since your purchase, we can’t offer you a full refund or exchange.

To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused and in the same condition that you received it. It must also be in the original packaging.

Several types of goods are exempt from being returned. Perishable goods such as food, flowers, newspapers or magazines cannot be returned. We also do not accept products that are intimate or sanitary goods, hazardous materials, or flammable liquids or gases.

Additional non-returnable items:

  • Gift cards
  • Downloadable software products
  • Some health and personal care items

To complete your return, we require a receipt or proof of purchase.

Please do not send your purchase back to the manufacturer.

There are certain situations where only partial refunds are granted:

  • Book with obvious signs of use
  • CD, DVD, VHS tape, software, video game, cassette tape, or vinyl record that has been opened.
  • Any item not in its original condition, is damaged or missing parts for reasons not due to our error.
  • Any item that is returned more than 30 days after delivery

Refunds

Once your return is received and inspected, we will send you an email to notify you that we have received your returned item. We will also notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund.

If you are approved, then your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your credit card or original method of payment, within a certain amount of days.

Late or missing refunds

If you haven’t received a refund yet, first check your bank account again.

Then contact your credit card company, it may take some time before your refund is officially posted.

Next contact your bank. There is often some processing time before a refund is posted.

If you’ve done all of this and you still have not received your refund yet, please contact us at {email address}.

Sale items

Only regular priced items may be refunded. Sale items cannot be refunded.

Exchanges

We only replace items if they are defective or damaged. If you need to exchange it for the same item, send us an email at {email address} and send your item to: {physical address}.

Gifts

If the item was marked as a gift when purchased and shipped directly to you, you’ll receive a gift credit for the value of your return. Once the returned item is received, a gift certificate will be mailed to you.

If the item wasn’t marked as a gift when purchased, or the gift giver had the order shipped to themselves to give to you later, we will send a refund to the gift giver and they will find out about your return.

Shipping returns

To return your product, you should mail your product to: {physical address}.

You will be responsible for paying for your own shipping costs for returning your item. Shipping costs are non-refundable. If you receive a refund, the cost of return shipping will be deducted from your refund.

Depending on where you live, the time it may take for your exchanged product to reach you may vary.

If you are returning more expensive items, you may consider using a trackable shipping service or purchasing shipping insurance. We don’t guarantee that we will receive your returned item.

Need help?

Contact us at {email} for questions related to refunds and returns.

item.title: The Art of Everyday Dressing: Building a Wardrobe That Works
item.dc:creator: monotheme
item.content:encoded:
A great wardrobe begins with intention. Instead of following every passing trend, focus on pieces that feel authentic, versatile, and easy to wear.

Start with a foundation of elevated essentials: a perfectly cut shirt, relaxed trousers, a lightweight knit, and a versatile outer layer. These pieces become the building blocks for countless outfits, allowing you to dress up or down without overthinking your choices.

Choose Quality Over Quantity

Investing in fewer, better-made pieces can completely change the way you approach getting dressed. Look for fabrics that feel comfortable against the skin, construction that holds its shape, and silhouettes that remain relevant beyond a single season.

Create Layers

Layering adds depth and flexibility to everyday outfits. Pair a simple tee with an overshirt, add a lightweight jacket, or combine contrasting textures to create a more considered look.

Let Your Personal Style Lead

The most important part of building a wardrobe is understanding what you actually enjoy wearing. Trends can provide inspiration, but personal style comes from discovering the colors, proportions, and silhouettes that make you feel confident.

A thoughtful wardrobe isn't about having more. It's about having the right pieces—and knowing how to make them work together.
item.excerpt:encoded: Great style doesn’t require a closet full of clothes. Discover how thoughtful essentials, timeless silhouettes, and a few statement pieces can create a wardrobe that works effortlessly every day.

item.title: The New Season Edit: Effortless Layers for Transitional Weather
item.dc:creator: monotheme
item.content:encoded:
Transitional weather is where a well-designed wardrobe really shines. The key is choosing lightweight layers that can adapt throughout the day without compromising your look.

Start with breathable base layers such as cotton tees, relaxed shirts, or lightweight knitwear. From there, add an overshirt, structured jacket, or relaxed blazer that can easily be removed as temperatures rise.

The Overshirt

Few pieces are as versatile as the modern overshirt. It works effortlessly over a basic tee and can also be styled underneath a heavier coat when temperatures drop.

Relaxed Trousers

Comfort and style no longer need to compete. Relaxed trousers create an easy silhouette while offering enough structure for both casual and elevated outfits.

Finish With Texture

The simplest way to make a layered outfit feel intentional is through texture. Combine cotton, denim, knitwear, suede, or lightweight wool to add subtle visual depth.

The result is a wardrobe that feels effortless, adaptable, and ready for whatever the day brings.
item.excerpt:encoded: As the seasons change, your wardrobe should become more versatile. Explore effortless layering ideas designed to take you comfortably from cool mornings to warmer afternoons.

item.title: Less, But Better: A Modern Guide to Conscious Fashion
item.dc:creator: monotheme
item.content:encoded:
Fashion is constantly evolving, but personal style doesn't have to move at the same pace. A conscious wardrobe starts by slowing down and choosing pieces with purpose.

Instead of asking, “What should I buy next?”, consider asking, “Will I still want to wear this next year?”

Look Beyond the Label

Material, construction, and care all play a role in how long a garment remains part of your wardrobe. Natural and responsibly sourced materials can be excellent choices when combined with thoughtful manufacturing and proper care.

Buy for Versatility

A versatile garment earns its place in your wardrobe. Look for pieces that can be styled in multiple ways and work across different occasions.

A simple shirt might become part of a relaxed weekend outfit, a polished office look, or an evening ensemble depending on how it is styled.

Take Care of What You Own

The most sustainable garment is often the one you already own. Follow care instructions, wash thoughtfully, repair when possible, and store clothing properly.

Conscious fashion isn't about perfection. It's about making better choices, one piece at a time.
item.excerpt:encoded: A more thoughtful approach to fashion starts with buying less and choosing better. Here are simple ways to build a wardrobe with longevity, versatility, and purpose in mind.

Fit & Sizing

    • Pendant Dimensions: 22 mm H × 18 mm W × 5 mm thickness

    • Chain Length: 45 cm + 5 cm extension chain (18" to 20")

    • Base Metal: Certified 925 sterling silver

    • Plating: Heavy 18k gold vermeil

  • Care Instructions: Remove before showering, swimming, or applying fragrance. Store separately in an anti-tarnish pouch.
item.excerpt:encoded: A tactile molten loop pendant cast with soft, asymmetrical contours and strung on a fluid micro snake chain in warm 18k yellow gold vermeil.

item.title: Monolith Steel Watch | 40 mm case diameter.
item.dc:creator: monotheme
item.content:encoded:
• Design & Concept: Stripped of all decorative clutter, the Monolith Steel Watch celebrates pure functional geometry. The dial features a satin-matte black finish with thin, raised silver hour markers and minimal hairline hands for clean legibility. A date window rests flush at the 4:30 position to preserve dial symmetry.

  • Case & Bracelet: The 40 mm case and three-link oyster-style bracelet are made from hypoallergenic 316L surgical steel with vertical satin brushing and mirror-chamfered bevels. Secured by a dual push-button deployant clasp.

  • Specifications:

    • Case Size: 40 mm diameter × 8.5 mm thickness

    • Lug Width: 20 mm

    • Movement: Japanese Miyota 3-hand quartz with quickset date

    • Glass: Scratch-resistant flat mineral crystal with anti-reflective sapphire coating

    • Water Resistance: 50 meters (5 ATM)
item.excerpt:encoded: A brushed 316L stainless steel analog watch featuring an unbranded matte black dial, slender baton indices, luminous hands, and a discrete date complication.

item.title: Minimalist Leather Everyday Tote | magnetic closure.
item.dc:creator: monotheme
item.content:encoded:
• Design & Concept: Stripped of unnecessary exterior hardware, this tote focuses on silhouette, proportion, and leather texture. The structured base allows the bag to stand upright, while the supple side panels drape naturally under the arm. Finished with hand-painted raw edges and a minimalist removable leather clochette tag.

  • Interior Architecture: Generous main compartment lined with durable tonal cotton canvas. Features one interior zippered valuables pocket, two slip compartments for phone and cards, and a magnetic snap closure for security.

  • Specifications:

    • Dimensions: 36 cm H × 42 cm W × 14 cm D

    • Handle Drop: 25.5 cm (10 inches)

    • Material: 100% full-grain semi-matte cowhide leather

    • Hardware: Matte black coated metal

  • Care Instructions: Wipe clean with a soft, dry microfiber cloth. Condition every 6 months with neutral leather balm.
item.excerpt:encoded: A structured matte black leather tote designed with clean lines, reinforced slim shoulder handles, and a detachable tonal leather tag. Built to carry everyday essentials, a water bottle, and up to a 15-inch laptop.

item.title: Girls Blazer Jacket Long Sleeve Solid Color Comfy Blazer Open Front
item.dc:creator: monotheme
item.content:encoded:
Design & Silhouette

  • Cut: Relaxed oversized boyfriend fit with clean architectural lines and dropped torso proportions.

  • Closure: Single-breasted front featuring minimalist tonal horn-effect buttons.

  • Lapel & Collar: Crisp notched lapel collar with clean under-collar melton stitching.

  • Pockets: One welt breast pocket, two lower flap pockets, and a discreet interior card pocket.

  • Finishing: Dual back vents for natural movement, buttoned cuffs, and a full satin interior lining that slides effortlessly over knitwear and tees.

Fabric & Composition

  • Shell: 68% Recycled Polyester, 28% Rayon, 4% Elastane (structured, wrinkle-resistant twill with subtle 2-way stretch).

  • Lining: 100% Breathable Viscose Satin.

Colorways

  • Available in six signature shades: Onyx Black, Warm Camel, Espresso Brown, Emerald Green, Midnight Navy, and Dusty Rose.

Fit & Sizing Guide

  • Designed intentionally for a relaxed, oversized profile.

  • Take your true size for the campaign look, or size down for a more fitted silhouette.

  • Model Stats: Height 5'9" (175 cm) / Bust 32" / Waist 25" / Wears Size S.
item.excerpt:encoded: A menswear-inspired silhouette designed with padded structured shoulders, clean notched lapels, and an effortless boxy drape. Crafted from a fluid, mid-weight tailored twill for seamless day-to-night capsule layering.

item.title: The Atelier Longline Wool-Blend Wrap Coat | low-dropped shoulders.
item.dc:creator: monotheme
item.content:encoded:
• Design & Silhouette:

    • Cut in an elongated maxi silhouette extending past mid-calf for dramatic, fluid movement while walking.

    • Generous, sharp notch lapels roll down into an open-front closure that can be worn relaxed or cinched with the matching self-tie fabric belt.

    • Low-slung dropped shoulders and wide, unrestrictive sleeves provide ample room for effortless layering over tailored pieces or chunky knitwear.

    • Deep interior side-seam pockets, clean turnback cuffs, and a straight-cut hem.

  • Fabric & Composition:

    • Shell: 70% Brushed Wool, 25% Polyamide, 5% Cashmere (double-faced construction for thermal retention without excess bulk).

    • Color: Slate Steel / Muted Petrol Blue.

    • Interior: Clean bias-bound seams with partial satin lining through the shoulders and sleeves for smooth wear over knit garments.

  • Fit & Sizing:

    • Designed for a relaxed, loose oversized silhouette.

    • Take your true size for an editorial look, or size down for a more streamlined fit.

    • Model Dimensions: Height 5'10" (178 cm), wearing Size S.

  • Care Instructions:

    • Professional dry clean only.

    • Cool iron or vertical garment steam as needed.
item.excerpt:encoded: An architectural maxi-length overcoat cut with exaggerated notch lapels, low-dropped shoulders, and a fluid, sweeping hemline. Crafted from a brushed, double-faced wool blend in muted slate blue, engineered to deliver structured drape and effortless motion.
